play_from_search: Play a song from the search bar
wait_listener_playing: Nobody in “{salon}”: playback is on hold and will resume as soon as a listener joins the channel.
wait_listener_paused: Nobody in “{salon}”: the bot will join the channel as soon as a listener connects.
tooltip_output_lufs: Measured loudness of the playing file, in LUFS. Two files of equal loudness are heard at the same level, whatever the volume.
tooltip_output_gain: Gain this track's loudness setting applies. It adds to the main volume without moving it.
playback_blocked_body: The browser will not start sound on its own for an address it barely knows yet. It learns with every listen: within a few sessions, resuming after a reload will be automatic again.
account_switch_owner: The account you choose will become the owner of this dashboard, in place of this one.
account_switch_keeps_owner: Ownership will stay with this account: taking it over requires the token, printed in the console of the machine running the bot. Another account will only have the rights granted to it here.
share_pending_hint: is asking to control the bot
tunnel_absent_body: The dashboard does not leave this machine. Tailscale gives it an address reachable from anywhere, without opening a port on your router. Installing it needs administrator rights: do that by hand, and this window picks up from there.
tunnel_absent_tip: Checks first that Tailscale has not been installed in the meantime, then starts the download
tunnel_recheck_installed_tip: Looks at this machine again to move on to the next step
tunnel_recheck_started_tip: Looks at this machine again to see whether the service answers
tunnel_recheck_enabled: It is enabled in the console
tunnel_recheck_enabled_tip: Looks again at the rights this Tailscale network grants the machine
tunnel_unreachable_body: The command is there, but the service does not answer. It is most likely stopped: start the Tailscale app, then try again.
tunnel_login_title: This machine belongs to no account
tunnel_login_body: Tailscale needs an account to give this machine an address. None is created automatically. Create yours, generate an auth key, and paste it here: the bot does the rest.
tunnel_capability_title: This account does not allow publishing yet
tunnel_capability_body: The machine is connected, but your Tailscale network does not grant the right to publish. It is enabled once and for all in the console: HTTPS certificates, then Funnel. Come back here afterwards.
tunnel_ready_body: Publishing makes the address reachable from the internet. Access itself does not change: without a Discord account you have accepted, all one sees is the sign-in page.
tunnel_serving_body: This address leads to the dashboard from anywhere. It doubles as the invite link.
tunnel_other_body: A tunnel already publishes something else on this machine. It will not be touched: someone may be using it. Remove it yourself if you want this address for the dashboard.
tooltip_hold_switch_account: Hold 1.5s to close the session and pick another Discord account
lufs_sync_sub: Bring every track to the same perceived level
no_playlists: Create a playlist to get started
no_playlist_tracks: No tracks in this playlist. Drag tracks here to get started.
maint_desc: Choose an action for the Discord bot.
login_gate_lead: This dashboard drives a bot that lives on your servers. It needs to know who you are before handing you the controls.
login_gate_scope: Only your id, your name and your avatar are requested.
login_gate_unconfigured_body: Set DISCORD_CLIENT_ID, DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET and PUBLIC_URL in the .env file, then declare the callback URL in the Discord developer portal.
login_gate_failed: The Discord sign-in did not go through. Try again.
modal_playlist_prompt: Enter a name for the new playlist:
presence_departure_delay: Delay before leaving an empty channel
presence_departure_delay_hint: Counted from the moment the last listener leaves. At 0s, the bot leaves right away.
settings_reset_success: All settings have been reset to default values
server_delete_prompt: Please type the server name {name} to confirm removal:
bounce_load: Box bounce animation on page load
bounce_style: Box bounce animation on style change
bounce_theme: Box bounce animation on theme change
bounce_guild: Box bounce animation on guild change
bounce_channel: Box bounce animation on channel change
video_no_source: No video available for this track
tooltip_search_input: Paste a link, type a search, or give the path of a file on the bot's machine.
import_info_desc_youtube: Link to a video, a playlist or an album.
import_info_desc_soundcloud: Link to a track or a set.
import_info_desc_spotify: Link to a track, an album or a playlist.
import_info_desc_apple: Link to a track or an album.
import_info_desc_search: A title, an artist: the best match is used.
import_info_desc_path: A file already on the machine hosting the bot.
import_info_desc_upload: The paperclip, which sends a file from your device to the bot.
import_info_bridge_note: Spotify and Apple Music do not serve their audio. The bot reads the track details, then finds the song on a source that allows it: the version played may differ slightly from the original.
import_info_formats_note: A file played from a folder on the bot's machine is only audible in the browser if that folder is listed in MEDIA_ROOTS. Otherwise it comes out in the voice channel only.
download_dir_gone: This folder is no longer reachable: {path}
download_dir_err_not_dir: This path is not a folder.
toast_unsupported_file_format: Unsupported file format. Please select an audio file.
toast_box_locked_move: The box "{title}" is locked. Unlock it to move it.
toast_box_locked_resize: The box "{title}" is locked. Unlock it to resize it.
toast_layout_saved_default: Current layout (position, box sizes and sliders) set as default.
grid_overlay_enable: Show the grid the boxes are laid out on
toast_hover_hint: Hovering a notification with the mouse prevents it from disappearing.
overlay_restarting_desc: The connection has been temporarily closed. The interface will automatically reconnect once the bot is operational.
overlay_shutdown_title: The bot is now shut down.
overlay_shutdown_desc: The server has been stopped properly. To restart it, you will need to start the bot process manually from the console.
overlay_restart_sync_desc: Real-time timing synchronization. Music will instantly resume from the exact playback position without any rollback or interruption.
overlay_shutdown_fadeout_desc: Gradually reducing volume (5s) and saving exact timing before the server shuts down completely.
logs_copy_failed: Copying is not available in this browser.
import_quality_download_notice: Download to a folder: the video definition does not apply, only audio is written.
import_quality_video_notice: Video container: the chosen resolution picks the stream, or sizes a black picture when the source has none.
quality_video_absent: This resolution does not exist for this media
quality_audio_capped: Beyond what the source carries: the file would be heavier, not better
import_quality_lossless_notice: FLAC and WAV are lossless: they keep everything, and the audio bitrate does not apply.
import_quality_hint: No effect on local files, which are imported as-is.
import_quality_local_notice: Local file detected: quality does not apply, it is imported as-is.
loudness_reset_hint: Back to the file's original level
loudness_failed: The loudness of this file could not be measured.
loudness_unavailable: Adjustable once the track has been preloaded.
loudness_synced_note: Synchronization is on — setting it here turns it off.
tooltip_drawer_edge: Move the mouse here to open the drawer
mem_estimate_note: Browsers do not expose real per-element memory. Nodes, attributes and decoded images are counted, then converted at 256 B per node; the heap and loaded code, by contrast, are measured.
version_copy_failed: Copy failed: select the number by hand.
version_none_published: No release published on the repository
version_modal_desc: The bot will download this version, install it alongside the others, then restart on it.
version_modal_desc_installed: This version is already on your PC: the bot will simply restart on it.
version_note_keep: Your current version is kept intact: nothing is ever overwritten.
version_note_dev: The development version is never modified or overwritten by this system.
version_already_running: This version is already the one running.
version_offline: Bot unreachable: cannot look up versions.
version_uninstall_desc: This version will be erased from your PC. You can reinstall it later from this same menu.
version_uninstall_note: Your playlists, settings and files are untouched: they live outside the versions.
docs_empty: No document found in the docs/ folder.
docs_hint: Arrows, wheel or click to turn pages
docs_hint_flow: Wheel or scrollbar to move through the document
share_oauth_missing_body: Set DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET and PUBLIC_URL in the .env file, then declare this redirect URL in the Discord developer portal:
share_invite_hint: Post the sign-in link in the voice channel chat
share_invite_sent: Link posted in the voice channel chat.
share_preset_dj_hint: Runs the music: playback, queue, transitions, level
share_preset_cohost_hint: Everything that can be shared, without exception
share_dismiss_tooltip: Clears their rights, closes their sessions and forgets them
share_not_connected_note: This person must first sign in with their Discord account. Send them the link above.
share_action_playlists_addTrack: Add a track to a playlist
share_action_playlists_removeTrack: Remove a track from a playlist
share_err_mute: This channel does not accept messages.
share_err_send: The bot could not write in that channel.
perm_denied_tooltip: Not granted by the session master
perm_denied_toast: The session master has not granted you this right.
perm_revoked_toast: Your access to the player has been revoked.
transition_no_target: No other source to go to.
transition_row_tooltip: Playback switches to that source here, then this row disappears.
tunnel_declare_action: Copy the callback URL and open Discord
tunnel_declare_tip: Not the address below: the callback URL is that same address, followed by the path Discord returns to. Opens your application’s OAuth2 page.
tunnel_declare_copied: Callback URL copied. In the tab that just opened:
tunnel_declare_step2: Paste the address into the field
tunnel_declare_step3: Save with “Save Changes” at the bottom of the page
tunnel_declare_uri_tip: The address to paste, in case the clipboard has been used since
